title: Polynomial-time uniformity of a circuit family
statement: A family assigning to each natural number $n$ a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ input vertices is polynomial-time uniform if there is a polynomial-time computable function on finite Boolean lists that, on the list of $n$ true bits, returns the encoding of the circuit assigned to $n$.
